get.description: GET /billing/stripe_config — returns the Stripe publishable key. No auth required; the publishable key is safe to expose.
GET /billing/balance — returns the current credit balance for the authenticated user.

parameters.name: X-Api-Key
parameters.description: API-mode auth: account or usage API key (alternatively `Authorization: Bearer <key>`). OR — for ChainSecured callers — omit X-Api-Key entirely and send `X-Wallet-Auth: <base64(JSON{typed_data, signature})>` where `typed_data` is EIP-712 with `primaryType: "BillingAuth"`. The signature proves wallet possession; the typed data must include the connected wallet address and an issuedAt timestamp within ±5 minutes.

post.description: POST /billing/create_payment_intent — creates a Stripe PaymentIntent and returns the client_secret for use with Stripe.js `confirmCardPayment`.

AccountOpResponse.description: Response for account config operations (add_pkp_to_group, remove_pkp_from_group, add_usage_api_key, remove_usage_api_key).

ConvertToChainSecuredAccountRequest.description: Body for `convert_to_chain_secured_account`. The caller is authenticated by their existing API key (header). The supplied wallet becomes the on-chain admin and the account flips from managed to ChainSecured. The conversion is irreversible.

new_admin_wallet_address.description: Hex-encoded EVM address (with or without 0x prefix). Must be the wallet the user controls; verified by an EIP-712 typed-data signature.

typed_data.description: EIP-712 typed-data object the wallet signed. Must use `primaryType: "ConvertAccount"` and the canonical schema (see `core::eip712`).

signature.description: 65-byte 0x-prefixed signature (r||s||v) over the EIP-712 digest of `typed_data`.

CreateWalletWithSignatureResponse.description: Returned by `/create_wallet_with_signature`. The client must follow up with an on-chain `registerWalletDerivation(adminHash, wallet_address, derivation_path, name, description)` call signed by the same wallet — until that lands, the PKP exists in MPC but is not registered to any account.

derivation_path.description: 0x-prefixed lowercase hex (uint256). Pass through verbatim to `registerWalletDerivation`'s `derivationPath` arg.

CreateWalletWithSignatureRequest.description:
ChainSecured wallet creation. The client signs EIP-712 typed data with their wallet; the server verifies the signature, mints a PKP via DStack MPC, and returns the new wallet address + derivation path so the client can register it on-chain via `registerWalletDerivation`.

The server does not maintain a nonce store. Replay protection is a ±5-minute window on the `issuedAt` field plus the per-flow primaryType binding — worst-case replay still just mints an extra unregistered PKP (compute cost only; registration requires a separate wallet signature on-chain).

typed_data.description: EIP-712 typed-data object the wallet signed. Must use `primaryType: "CreateWallet"` and the canonical schema (see `core::eip712`).

signature.description: 65-byte 0x-prefixed signature (r||s||v) over the EIP-712 digest of `typed_data`.

DeleteWalletRequest.description:
Request for delete_wallet (AccountConfig.removeWalletDerivation). Master (account) API key via header — usage API keys are rejected on-chain (`NotMasterAccount`).

HARD DELETE: permanently and irreversibly removes the wallet (PKP) and wipes its on-chain derivation path. Anything secured by the wallet becomes unrecoverable.

wallet_address.description: Wallet (PKP) address to permanently delete: 20-byte hex, with an optional `0x`/`0X` prefix.

LitActionRequest.description:
API key via header.

Provide either `code` (inline JS) or `ipfs_id` (IPFS CID of a previously-cached action). When `code` is provided it is cached by its IPFS hash so subsequent calls can use `ipfs_id`.

code.description: Inline JS source. Optional when `ipfs_id` is supplied.

ipfs_id.description: IPFS CID of a previously-submitted action. Looked up in the in-memory cache.

AddGroupResponse.description: Response for add_group, includes the on-chain group ID.

AddGroupRequest.description: Request for add_group. permitted_actions and pkps are keccak256 hashes as hex strings (with or without 0x). API key via header.

group_name.description: Name of the group (Group.metadata.name in AccountConfig.sol).

group_description.description: Description of the group (Group.metadata.description in AccountConfig.sol).

pkp_ids_permitted.description: pkp ids permitted to use the group (AccountConfig.sol Group.pkpId).

cid_hashes_permitted.description: Actions permitted to use the group (AccountConfig.sol Group.cidHash).

action_ipfs_cid.description: IPFS CID for the action (keccak256-hashed on server).

DeleteActionRequest.description: Request for delete_action. hashed_cid is already a keccak256 hash (hex string). API key via header.

hashed_cid.description: Already-hashed CID for the action (0x-prefixed hex string).

action_ipfs_cid.description: IPFS CID for the action (will be keccak256-hashed on server).

AddUsageApiKeyResponse.description: Response for account config operations (add_group, add_pkp_to_group, remove_pkp_from_group, add_usage_api_key, remove_usage_api_key).

AddUsageApiKeyRequest.description: Request for add_usage_api_key. expiration and balance as decimal strings (e.g. unix timestamp, wei). API key via header.

manage_ipfs_ids_in_groups.description: Group IDs to grant manage-IPFS-IDs permission. 0 is wildcard for all groups.

add_pkp_to_groups.description: Group IDs to grant add-PKP permission. 0 is wildcard for all groups.

remove_pkp_from_groups.description: Group IDs to grant remove-PKP permission. 0 is wildcard for all groups.

execute_in_groups.description: Group IDs to grant execute permission. 0 is wildcard for all groups.

AddUsageApiKeyWithSignatureResponse.description: Returned by `/add_usage_api_key_with_signature`. The client must follow up with on-chain `registerWalletDerivation(adminHash, wallet_address, derivation_path, name, description)` and `setUsageApiKey(adminHash, keccak256(usage_api_key), …)` — both signed by the admin wallet — to attach the usage key to the ChainSecured account.

usage_api_key.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte secret. Send as `X-Api-Key` / `Authorization: Bearer …` for usage requests; pass `keccak256(this)` to `setUsageApiKey`.

wallet_address.description: 0x-prefixed lowercase hex EVM address of the minted PKP wallet.

derivation_path.description: 0x-prefixed lowercase hex (uint256). Pass through verbatim to `registerWalletDerivation`'s `derivationPath` arg.

AddUsageApiKeyWithSignatureRequest.description: ChainSecured usage-key minting. Mirrors `CreateWalletWithSignatureRequest`: the user proves wallet ownership with an EIP-712 typed-data signature, the server mints a usage-key wallet via DStack MPC and returns the secret (as the usage API key) plus address + derivation path. The client follows up with on-chain `registerWalletDerivation` and `setUsageApiKey` signed by their admin wallet — only the admin wallet of a ChainSecured account can call `setUsageApiKey` (see AppStorage.accountExistsAndIsMutable).

typed_data.description: EIP-712 typed-data object the wallet signed. Must use `primaryType: "AddUsageApiKey"` and the canonical schema (see `core::eip712`).

signature.description: 65-byte 0x-prefixed signature (r||s||v) over the EIP-712 digest of `typed_data`.

UpdateUsageApiKeyRequest.description: Request for update_usage_api_key. Updates all permissions and metadata on an existing usage API key. API key via header.

manage_ipfs_ids_in_groups.description: Group IDs to grant manage-IPFS-IDs permission. 0 is wildcard for all groups.

add_pkp_to_groups.description: Group IDs to grant add-PKP permission. 0 is wildcard for all groups.

remove_pkp_from_groups.description: Group IDs to grant remove-PKP permission. 0 is wildcard for all groups.

execute_in_groups.description: Group IDs to grant execute permission. 0 is wildcard for all groups.

UpdateGroupRequest.description: Request for update_group (AccountConfig.updateGroup). API key via header.

RemoveActionFromGroupRequest.description: Request for remove_action_from_group. hashed_cid is already a keccak256 hash (hex string). API key via header.

hashed_cid.description: Already-hashed CID for the action (0x-prefixed hex string).

UpdateActionMetadataRequest.description: Request for update_action_metadata. hashed_cid is already a keccak256 hash (hex string). API key via header.

hashed_cid.description: Already-hashed CID for the action (0x-prefixed hex string).

UpdateUsageApiKeyMetadataRequest.description: Request for update_usage_api_key_metadata (AccountConfig.updateUsageApiKeyMetadata). API key via header.

ListMetadataItem.description: One item from list_groups, list_wallets, list_wallets_in_group, or list_actions (AccountConfig.sol Metadata).

WalletItem.description: One item from list_groups, list_wallets, list_wallets_in_group, or list_actions (AccountConfig.sol Metadata).

ChainConfigKeysResponse.description: GET /get_chain_config_keys — names of every supported ConfigKeys variant.

LitActionClientConfigResponse.description: GET /get_lit_action_client_config — effective ClientBuilder configuration values, including any chain-config overrides applied at startup.

CacheMetadataResponse.description: GET /cache_metadata — metadata for the cached action code correlated to the authenticated master account. Excludes the cached binaries themselves.

account_address.description: On-chain account wallet address the caller's key resolves to.

entry_count.description: Number of cached entries correlated to this account.

total_size_bytes.description: Sum of `size_bytes` across the returned entries.

entries.description: The cached entries, sorted by most recent execution first.

CacheEntryMetadataItem.description:
One cached action-code entry in a `GET /cache_metadata` response (CPL-351).

Describes the cached data only — never the code/binary itself.

ipfs_id.description: IPFS id (cache key) of the cached action code.

size_bytes.description: Size of the cached code in bytes.

created_at_ms.description: Unix-epoch milliseconds when the entry was first cached.

last_run_at_ms.description: Unix-epoch milliseconds of the most recent execution.

run_count.description: Number of executions recorded against this entry.

ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live of the entry, in seconds. `None` for the API-server IPFS cache, which is capacity-bounded (LRU) rather than time-expired.

StripeConfigResponse.description: GET /billing/stripe_config — returns the Stripe publishable key for Stripe.js.

BillingBalanceResponse.description: GET /billing/balance — current credit balance for the authenticated API key.

balance_cents.description: Balance in cents.  Negative means credits are available; zero means exhausted.

CreatePaymentIntentResponse.description: POST /billing/create_payment_intent — client secret for Stripe.js confirmCardPayment.

amount_cents.description: Amount to charge in US cents (minimum 500 = $5.00).
